column1: # cases.tsv - four TAB-separated fields: id, expect, assertion, note
#   expect     clean   = check-plan-page.py must report no finding on pages/<id>.html
#              finding = it must report at least one, under the assertion named
#   assertion  capability | network | script | none (for a clean page)
# A built plan page is held to these AND to the template's script byte for
# byte; these hand-made pages carry their own script, so that half is not
# applied to them. The clean pages are as important as the others: a check
# that flags every page is switched off as fast as one that flags none.
